results.rationale: Most coral branches remain saturated pink rather than turning white; only the base becomes pale and develops two large eye-like features. That invented face and changed base anatomy are unrelated to depigmentation, while blue water and reef composition remain recognizable. The eye-bearing coral is a major anatomical hallucination. Instruction failure ⇒ knowledge invalid.

A wooden Chinese-style boat is added to the river, but its tall rectangular pavilion cabin differs from the specified low black-canopied Wu-peng boat. Hills, sky, banks and field remain consistent with slight tree-texture variation. The boat has coherent hull geometry, plausible placement and a matching water reflection.
